versionRule.minor: Additive: a new request, a new push, a new optional field or a new capability. Nothing a client already sends or reads changes meaning.
versionRule.major: Anything a client written against an older version could not survive: a request, push or field removed or renamed, a field made required, or a meaning changed.
versionRule.window: A home answers every request of a client whose major is its own or one of the majorsBehind before it. A client on any other major, older or newer, is answered its reads (effect read) and sent every push, and each change (effect change) is refused until the client is updated. The welcome's access says which the client got.
versionRule.reading: A client ignores fields, pushes and capabilities it does not know, so what the home sends is published open. The home ignores envelope fields it does not know; a request's arguments are read as published.
versionRule.refusals: The home checks more than these shapes can say, such as sizes in bytes and rules across fields. Its refusal comes back as the result's error.
